responsibility: Supplies PDP-11-specific machine modes and floating-format bindings beyond GCC defaults. In particular it introduces CCNZmode for condition-code results where only N and Z are meaningful after arithmetic or floating operations, allowing the backend to model branch validity separately from full CCmode, and it remaps SF and DF to the target’s pdp11_f_format and pdp11_d_format encodings so real constants and memory layout use PDP-11/VAX-style floating representation.
